svg.title: 30e New budget
svg.text: Saved as a draft. Submit it when the lines are in; the Executive Approver approves it.

g.text: Its donor, department and cost centre fill in
Account codes and cost centres come from Setup; the Excel import checks every row against them before anything is saved.
Lines can change freely while it is a draft
Requisitions can draw on it; changes only by revision
Whoever prepares a budget can't approve it.
